notes.title: Update: New Combo Enemy Variant!
notes.notes:
Hello!

First off, thank you for over 1,000 library adds in the first 24 hours! The team is thrilled to see so much interest in the game and we can't thank you enough.

To celebrate, we've gone ahead and added a new combo enemy variant! It is just for visual variety, and was originally something we weren't able to add to the original game. But after seeing the initial positive reception, we decided it was worth going back and adding, so hopefully you enjoy it!

Other small changes include tweaks to SFX, slight adjustments to the rank/score bar animation, and a new fireworks effect at the end of the level.
